title: Registry gate allowed remote JavaScript module imports

reproduction.beforeFix: Both forms passed the source-isolation check.
reproduction.afterFix: The static and dynamic import examples fail with a remote module request violation.

rootCause: The previous outbound-request patterns did not inspect module-loading syntax.
remediation: The TypeScript AST scan rejects statically resolved HTTP(S) import, export-from, import(), and require() module specifiers without executing the submitted source.

validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: the static remote import returned pass

runtimeBoundary: The source gate complements, but does not replace, isolated preview origin and CSP enforcement. Deployed verification remains pending.
